audit.label: Available and frozen cash never negative
audit.detail: Cash and IPO escrow are finite and non-negative.

audit.label: IPO escrow matches all pending bids
audit.detail: Every reserved rupee maps to an unallocated IPO bid.

audit.label: IPO bids obey 200–500 whole-share minimum/maximum and holding cap
audit.detail: Every pending IPO bid is a whole-share quantity from 200 to 500 and fits the remaining company holding cap.

audit.label: IPO active-window pointer matches phase
audit.detail: Exactly one active IPO window is referenced during bidding; no stale pointer remains after settlement.

audit.label: Company and IPO count limits
audit.detail: The game has 8–10 companies and no more than two IPO companies.

audit.label: Portfolio arithmetic includes IPO escrow
audit.detail: Available cash + frozen IPO funds + holdings value is consistent.

audit.label: Holdings matrix matches player state
audit.detail: Every player has one non-negative integer quantity per stock.

audit.label: All player/company state arrays match company count
audit.detail: Holdings, average cost, special state, IPO bids, lots and overflow flags have matching lengths.

audit.label: Holding lots reconcile to total holdings
audit.detail: Every held share is tracked to a positive whole-share lot with a valid acquisition Sub-Round.

audit.label: Company supply invariant = 10,000
audit.detail: For every company, player holdings + available shares + treasury shares equals 10,000.

audit.label: Normal holding cap and event exceptions
audit.detail: Only explicitly flagged corporate-action holdings exceed 2,500.

audit.label: IPO allocation respects 2,500-share cap
audit.detail: IPO allocations obey the 2,500 cap; explicitly flagged later corporate-action shares may exceed it.

audit.label: Action count / distinct-company rule
audit.detail: No player repeats a company or exceeds the action limit.

audit.label: Pending action shape and quantity fields
audit.detail: All pending actions have a valid type, company index and share quantity.

audit.label: Locked decision batches are fully validated before resolution
audit.detail: Every committed batch has valid company references, exact order prices, legal BUY/SELL/SKIP quantities, holding-cap compliance and sufficient available cash.

audit.label: R1 Sub-Round 1 compulsory-buy lock gate
audit.detail: Every locked/committed R1 SR1 player has 2–5 valid BUYs in distinct tradable companies.

audit.label: History has valid sub-round identity
audit.detail: Every history entry stores round/sub-round and a full price/supply/portfolio snapshot.

audit.label: History preserves each Sub-Round opening price baseline
audit.detail: Every immutable history record includes the opening price of every company for circuit auditing.

audit.label: Total Sub-Round price movement respects ±5% circuits
audit.detail: All non-corporate-adjustment closing prices remain inside the opening-price ±5% band, including event reactions.

audit.label: Immutable history snapshots reconcile supply
audit.detail: Every historical company snapshot reconciles holdings + available + treasury to 10,000.

audit.label: VITO restoration matches immutable Sub-Round history
audit.detail: Every history record with a VITO restoration stores the restored price and matching round identity.

audit.label: Decision intel includes listed zero-price stocks but excludes unlisted IPOs
audit.detail: Listed companies remain eligible for private card pressure at ₹0 and during VITO trading halts; unlisted IPOs are excluded.

audit.label: Market indices (NIFTY/SENSEX/BANK NIFTY/USD-INR/VIX) valid
audit.detail: All five game-brain market indices are finite.

audit.label: Price range ₹0–₹10,000
audit.detail: All prices remain in the defined range.

audit.label: One VITO flag per player/game
audit.detail: VITO usage is tracked per player, not per company.

audit.label: Trade journal matches actual fills and SELL limits
audit.detail: Every journal row records a valid executed fill, exact cash delta, and SELL quantity within the eligible-share cap.

audit.label: Cash ledger reconciles to trade and event journals
audit.detail: Ledger baseline is not active in this pre-game fixture; live reconciliation activates at game start.

audit.label: Share ledger reconciles to trade, corporate-event and IPO journals
audit.detail: Ledger baseline is not active in this pre-game fixture; live reconciliation activates at game start.

audit.label: Pending BUY orders are valid, affordable 200–500 share orders
audit.detail: Every queued BUY is tradable, within the normal holding cap and affordable from available cash.

audit.label: Pending SELL orders obey maturity, minimum and 50% cap
audit.detail: Every queued SELL is mature, at least 200 shares, and within the allowed eligible-share cap.

audit.label: Event journal attribution, IPO settlement and VITO rollback linkage
audit.detail: Event deltas name the affected player, IPO reservation = spent + refunded, and VITO reversals link to the correct bankruptcy ID.

audit.label: Quit players remain frozen
audit.detail: Active players are not frozen and every inactive player retains frozen portfolio state.
